visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a woman in a white dress standing by an infinity pool that overlooks a coastal resort nestled against a rocky, sunlit cliff. The scene transitions to the woman inside a luxury room, holding a baby on a large bed with patterned pillows and tribal art on the wall. (2) The woman appears in a close-up, wearing a straw hat and white shirt, speaking animatedly to the camera while standing in front of a wooden door. She gestures frequently with her hands to emphasize her points. (3) A room tour follows, starting with a large open-plan living room featuring white curved sofas, a long stone dining table decorated with driftwood, and high ceilings with white-washed wooden beams. (4) The camera pans to a private outdoor patio that includes a circular plunge pool and woven chairs, with a view of a sandy beach and the blue ocean beyond. (5) Inside, a modern kitchen with high-end appliances and a large island is shown, followed by a laundry room with a front-loading washer and dryer. (6) The tour continues into a master bedroom with a large unmade bed and floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to the patio. A spacious bathroom with a standalone white tub, a double vanity, and a glass-enclosed shower is also presented. (7) Moving to the second floor, a bedroom with two queen beds and a wooden baby crib is displayed. The crib contains a blue elephant plush and a baby robe. Close-ups show miniature luxury toiletries specifically for children. (8) The final sequence returns to the woman on a balcony overlooking the resort grounds and ocean at sunset, gesturing and talking directly to the viewer.
